info.title: ForgeCRM API
info.description:
ForgeCRM REST API.

## Authentication

Sign in with POST /api/v1/auth/login, which sets the session cookie
`forgecrm_session`. State-changing requests must also send the CSRF token
returned by GET /api/v1/auth/me in the `X-CSRF-Token` header.

## Errors

Every failure returns RFC 9457 Problem Details with `type`, `title`,
`status`, `detail`, `instance` and `retryable`, and repeats the
machine-readable code under `error`. Branch on `error.code`; `title` is prose
and may change. See docs/api/errors.md.

## Collections

List operations accept `limit`, `offset`, `q`, `sort` and `order`, and return
`{items, total, limit, offset}`. `limit` is clamped by the server, so a large
value is not an error.

## Long operations

Imports, migrations and exports return a job identifier instead of blocking
the request. Poll GET /api/v1/jobs/{id}.

## Permissions

Each operation states the permission it requires. A caller without it receives
403. Authorisation is enforced on the server; the interface only decides what
to display.
